experiment: R1C (D-257): the cut owns geometry and construction, the model owns the design

meta.kind: a bounded method experiment: no catalogue, no runtime, no activation, no item approval

privacy.cSentToApi: allowed for this one call only (owner, 2026-10-30)
privacy.canvasSentToApi: allowed for this one call only (the private bleed canvas v2, derived from a generated item on C)

frozen.evaluation: tools/avatar/northstar-r1c-evaluate.mjs (placement, every automatic check, the review sheets and the record)
frozen.noChangeDuringTheExperiment: the canvas, prompt, placement, construction layer, post-processing, checks and their thresholds are not changed after receipt; any later correction is a new method version

deviationsFromPlanV1.what: Image 1 is the bleed canvas v2, not the plan's v1 (6f7af80c...)
deviationsFromPlanV1.why: v1 carried the template item's own drawn lines in its fold shade (neck rib line, sleeve seams, hem stitch) and a darker ring in the bleed: both invite the model to draw lines the cut draws itself; v2 closes the shade (3 px), softens it (9x9 mean), takes the edge zone and the bleed from the interior, and runs the trim tone into the bleed only beyond the neck and cuff edges

deviationsFromPlanV1.what: the placement's reference shape is the cut's core grown by the ESTIMATED bleed b (0 to 30 px), not a fixed 16 px
deviationsFromPlanV1.why: D-258's study: a fixed reference turned a 24 px or 10 px bleed into a wrong scale and a false trim fault; with b estimated the scale is right for 0 to 24 px and an output without bleed fails the coverage check

deviationsFromPlanV1.what: the second-outline and clipped-detail checks find lines by contrast and valley, not by an ink colour class
deviationsFromPlanV1.why: D-258's study: the ink class saw only near-black lines and missed a brown pocket across the edge

deviationsFromPlanV1.what: a tone-leak check (the canvas's grey kept in the material) and an explicit list of visual criteria
deviationsFromPlanV1.why: the owner's instruction: the reference's bands and tones must not end as visible colours; visual criteria never count as automatic passes

request.canvasGenerator: northstar-r1c-evaluate.mjs canvasV2 (via cutOf; deterministic; the evaluation refuses a rebuilt canvas that differs)

placement.rule: one uniform scale and one translation (s1) maximising the IoU of the output's opaque mask with the cut's core grown by b, b estimated in 0 to 30 px (coarse every 4, then +-2)
placement.noDeformation: the output is never warped, retouched or masked; b only names the reference shape

postProcessing.allowed: s1 as above, then composeC1: the cut's alpha, the output's own pixels, the cut's construction lines (contour, band edges, hem stitch), the production sleeve split, the cut's shadow and covering
postProcessing.forbidden: retouch, deformation, a per-design mask or parameter, filling a hole by any means
postProcessing.holes: counted on the output BEFORE the construction lines are drawn, including those a line would later cover

automatic.coverage: the core grown by 4 px covered >= 99.9 % before any crop
automatic.holesBeforeLines: 0 core pixels without the output's own paint
automatic.trim: trim edge P90 <= 2 px from the cut's band edge at the neck and at the cuffs (a plain trim passes and is reported)
automatic.secondOutline: the output's own lines (contrast >= 30 below the 7x7 mean and a 15-level valley) 2 to 10 px inside the cut's edge or along the band edges <= 0.5 % of the band area
automatic.clippedDetails: 0 line components reaching 6 px into the core and outside the cut
automatic.toneLeak: <= 1 % of the core neutral grey within 12 levels of the canvas tone (for a grey design: visual, never automatic)
automatic.fit: fitCheck (d232 fit revision) passed with the cut's shadow and covering
automatic.outfits: with the K partners: the cut's template item's result in every outfit; a difference is reviewed

visual: neck: the rib follows the opening; one line at its inner edge; no second line; no white sliver
armpits: fabric to the cut's contour; no notch; no background
cuffs: the trim ends at the sleeve opening; one line at its edge; not clipped
hem and side seams: one stitch line, not two; the hem not cut
pocket: whole, inside the body, naturally placed
folds: shading once, not doubled; the folds belong to the fabric
material: new fabric, folds, pocket and details from the output (not a recolour of the canvas)
trim colour: the bands read as trim of the design, not as the canvas's grey
Northstar quality at full size and at 110x165 and 52x78
no skin, hands or background inside the material

classes.automaticallyUsable: every automatic check passed AND the visual review finds none of the visual faults
classes.technicallyRejected: placement, coverage, holes or fit failed
classes.requiresManualDecision: anything else; it does not count as passed

acceptance.combo2: the known COMBO-2 pattern sensitivity (D-253) is reported apart; the check is not changed
acceptance.scope: one result can support or weaken the r1-c1 hypothesis; it cannot prove automation at scale nor reject every R1 variant

stopRules: a single call: no retry, no reserve, no fallback, no other model
uncertain dispatch: DISPATCHED_RESULT_UNKNOWN, NOT_DISPATCHED, RESPONSE_BODY_UNREADABLE, UNEXPECTED, or a claim without a written outcome — never resent
any HTTP error, moderation block or format error ends the experiment with that outcome
